pairs.l: 1 — has a job connected with food?
3 — studied a subject connected to food?
4 — says that they are not good at cooking?
5 — had to change their diet for health reasons?
6 — says that food from restaurants is expensive?
7 — has the chance to eat in first-class restaurants?
8 — doesn't like trying new kinds of food?
9 — says it's important to eat healthy food?
10 — eats at home more than they used to?
11 — is not interested in healthy food?
12 — mentions the use of technology in cooking?

r1.exp: 1=D (David: food critic, 'dining in exclusive restaurants'). 2=E (Emily: 'kind of therapy for escaping stress'). 3=B (Beatrice: 'graduated as a nutritionist'). 4=A (Anne: 'like a fish out of water... can manage omelettes'). 5=F (Frank: 'diagnosed as a migraine sufferer, dairy products the first thing to go'). 6=A (Anne: 'takeaway would undoubtedly cost the earth'). 7=D (David: 'sample wonderful creations virtually every day... exclusive seafood restaurants'). 8=C (Clive: 'I'm hardly the adventurous type'). 9=B (Beatrice: 'crucial to avoid eating too much red meat'). 10=E (Emily: 'I prefer staying in' — wait, that's Anne. Emily: used to eat in canteen, now cooks at home). 11=C (Clive: 'Organic food... all pass me by'). 12=A (Anne: 'who needs culinary expertise when there's the old microwave?').

r13.exp: 'It TRANSFORMED our view of ourselves' = promijenilo način na koji gledamo na Zemlju = C.

r14.exp: 'Earthrise is a striking reminder of EARTH'S VULNERABILITY. There is nothing that will come to SAVE it.' = nemoćna = B (helpless).

r15.exp: 'Originally meant only to CHECK THE TRACKING AND COMMUNICATIONS EQUIPMENT' = testiranje opreme = A.

r16.exp: 'A couple of hours later, he was struck by a fit of VOMITING' = bio je bolestan = D (was sick).

r17.exp: 'STARTLED responses' = iznenađeni = C (surprised to see it). Nitko nije očekivao taj prizor.

r18.exp: 'Gave a clear ENVIRONMENTAL MESSAGE – this is our fragile home, and we have to TAKE CARE OF IT' = naglasilo brigu o planetu = B.

r19.exp: 'Main reason for radio is music. (19)___. As a result, not regular listeners.' → F: they prefer online sites to CHOOSE SONGS instead of what the DJ chooses. Radiju ne slušaju jer na internetu mogu sami birati glazbu.

r20.exp: 'Teenagers do not want to watch TV adverts. (20)___.' → B: So they switch to another channel, or do something else. Reklame → mijenjaju kanal.

r21.exp: 'Tabloids, compact size, easy on public transport. (21)___. Reluctant to pay.' → H: This is especially true for the ones distributed free on buses and trains. Besplatni tablodi na prijevozu.

r22.exp: 'Only small percentage buy things online. (22)___.' → D: a credit card is required and most teenagers don't have credit cards. Objašnjava ZAŠTO ne kupuju online.

r23.exp: 'Visit the cinema regardless of what is on. (23)___. Going to cinema is not about the film, but the EXPERIENCE.' → A: They often choose what they will see when they get there. Idu bez plana, biraju na licu mjesta.

r24.exp: 'Don't choose expensive phone. (24)___. For the SAME REASON, don't upgrade often.' → G: risk of losing it, can't afford replacements. Isti razlog za jeftine telefone i rijetko nadogradnje.

r25.exp: 'To PRESERVE animals in their natural habitat' — 'preserve' = čuvati, sačuvati (u prirodnom staništu). 'Conserve' je blisko ali 'preserve' je točan odgovor prema ključu.

r26.exp: 'AT the same time' — fiksni izraz: at the same time = istovremeno.

r27.exp: 'The ugly tourist WOULD fly off' — 'would' za tipično prošlo ponašanje (used to do).

r28.exp: 'A hotel WHOSE sewage killed the coral reef' — posvojni relativni 'whose' (hotel čije je otpadne vode...). Jedino 'whose' ispravno povezuje hotel s otpadnim vodama.

r29.exp: 'Today, HOWEVER, tourists seem more interested in saving the earth' — 'however' za kontrast s prethodnom rečenicom (bad old days vs. today).

r30.exp: 'Working OUT as planned' — frazalni glagol: work out = odvijati se, ispostaviti se (as planned = prema planu).

r31.exp: 'Not if one CONSIDERS the 20,000 tourists' — 'consider' uz objekt (razmotriti, uzeti u obzir).

r32.exp: 'Help prevent them FROM being killed' — fiksna konstrukcija: prevent sb FROM doing sth = spriječiti da budu ubijeni.

r33.exp: 'Not only a brand BUT also...' — fiksni izraz: not only... but also = ne samo... nego i.

r34.exp: 'He HAD been skiing' — past perfect za radnju koja se dogodila prije druge prošle radnje (dizajnirao cipele nakon ozljede).

r35.exp: 'Create his OWN' (shoes) — posvojni 'own' naglašava da je napravio vlastite cipele.

r36.exp: 'Support for the ankle, WHICH made walking easier' — relativna zamjenica 'which' u ne-restriktivnoj surečenici (uz zarez).

r37.exp: 'As SOON as Martens and Funck began marketing' — fiksni izraz: as soon as = čim (tada odmah).

r38.exp: 'Went ON sale in 1960' — fiksna kolokacija: go on sale = ići u prodaju.

r39.exp: 'In ORDER to reduce the costs' — fiksni izraz: in order to = kako bi (s ciljem da).

r40.exp: 'It MAKES no difference' — fiksna kolokacija: make no difference = nema razlike, nije važno.

sol.rubric: Esej 200-250 riječi. ZA jedan jezik: lakša komunikacija, manje prevoditelja, ujedinjenje čovječanstva. PROTIV: gubitak kulturnog identiteta, nestanak jezične raznolikosti, dominacija jednog naroda. Vlastito mišljenje.

w1.exp: Esej — ručno se ocjenjuje. Diskusijski esej (discuss both views + opinion). Viša razina: akademski stil, složene strukture, bogat vokabular, 200–250 riječi.

l6.exp: Prema ključu: Q6 = C (It was fair).

l10.exp: Prema ključu: Q10 = C (In a house).

l13.exp: Prema ključu: Q13 = B (They were surprised).
